$comment: Agent notes for forum topics: topics in forum supergroups and in private chats with topics, the 'General' topic, topic icons. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite.

createForumTopic.purpose: Create a topic in a forum supergroup or a private chat with a user; returns a ForumTopic.
use_when: one thread per ticket, order or job
a private chat with topics split into conversations
avoid_when: a supergroup that is not a forum (Chat.is_forum unset)

pitfalls.text: icon_color must be one of six fixed RGB values, e.g. 7322096; name is 1-128 characters.
pitfalls.cite: icon_color: Currently, must be one of 7322096 (0x6FB9F0), 16766590 (0xFFD67E), ...

pitfalls.text: icon_custom_emoji_id must come from getForumTopicIconStickers.
pitfalls.cite: icon_custom_emoji_id: Use getForumTopicIconStickers to get all allowed custom emoji identifiers.

pitfalls.text: Private chat: https://t.me/<bot_username>/<message_thread_id> opens the topic only for that user.
pitfalls.cite: createForumTopic: the link opens the topic only for the user

pitfalls.text: Whether a private chat needs has_topics_enabled on is not stated; not tested.
Store message_thread_id with the ticket: later calls address the topic by it.

createForumTopic.rights: supergroup: admin with can_manage_topics (method text); private chat: none named

editForumTopic.purpose: Rename a topic or change its icon in a forum supergroup or a private chat with a user.
use_when: a ticket's state shown in its topic name
a topic whose name is implicit (ForumTopic.is_name_implicit)

pitfalls.text: Omitted or empty name keeps the name; omitted icon_custom_emoji_id keeps the icon, an empty string removes it.
pitfalls.cite: icon_custom_emoji_id: Pass an empty string to remove the icon. If not specified, the current icon will be kept.

pitfalls.text: There is no icon_color parameter: the color is set only by createForumTopic.
pitfalls.cite: editForumTopic parameters: chat_id, message_thread_id, name, icon_custom_emoji_id

pitfalls.text: In a supergroup a bot that created the topic needs no can_manage_topics.
pitfalls.cite: editForumTopic: must have the can_manage_topics administrator rights, unless it is the creator of the topic

pitfalls.text: Rename on real state changes, not as a progress bar.

editForumTopic.rights: supergroup: admin with can_manage_topics unless the bot created the topic (method text); private chat: none named

closeForumTopic.purpose: Close an open topic in a forum supergroup.
use_when: a ticket or discussion is resolved and the thread should stop
avoid_when: removing the topic and its messages: deleteForumTopic

pitfalls.text: The method text names forum supergroups only, not private chats.
pitfalls.cite: closeForumTopic: close an open topic in a forum supergroup chat

pitfalls.text: A bot that created the topic needs no can_manage_topics.
pitfalls.cite: closeForumTopic: must have the can_manage_topics administrator rights, unless it is the creator of the topic

pitfalls.text: Who can still post in a closed topic is not stated in the Bot API; not tested.
Send the closing note first, then close.

closeForumTopic.rights: admin with can_manage_topics unless the bot created the topic (method text)

reopenForumTopic.purpose: Reopen a closed topic in a forum supergroup.

pitfalls.text: The method text names forum supergroups only, not private chats.
pitfalls.cite: reopenForumTopic: reopen a closed topic in a forum supergroup chat

pitfalls.text: A bot that created the topic needs no can_manage_topics.
pitfalls.cite: reopenForumTopic: must have the can_manage_topics administrator rights, unless it is the creator of the topic

reopenForumTopic.rights: admin with can_manage_topics unless the bot created the topic (method text)

deleteForumTopic.purpose: Delete a topic with all its messages in a forum supergroup or a private chat with a user.
use_when: a topic whose content must go
avoid_when: ending a discussion but keeping its history: closeForumTopic (supergroups only)

pitfalls.text: Every message of the topic is deleted with it.
pitfalls.cite: deleteForumTopic: delete a forum topic along with all its messages

pitfalls.text: In a supergroup the right is can_delete_messages, not can_manage_topics.
pitfalls.cite: deleteForumTopic: must have the can_delete_messages administrator rights

pitfalls.text: Treat it as irreversible: confirm with a human admin and log who and why.

deleteForumTopic.rights: supergroup: admin with can_delete_messages (method text); private chat: none named

unpinAllForumTopicMessages.purpose: Clear the pinned messages of one topic in a forum supergroup or a private chat with a user.
use_when: resetting a topic's pins, e.g. an outdated status card

pitfalls.text: In a supergroup the right is can_pin_messages, not can_manage_topics.
pitfalls.cite: unpinAllForumTopicMessages: must have the can_pin_messages administrator right in the supergroup

pitfalls.text: It clears the topic's whole pinned list, not only the bot's pins.
pitfalls.cite: unpinAllForumTopicMessages: clear the list of pinned messages in a forum topic

unpinAllForumTopicMessages.rights: supergroup: admin with can_pin_messages (method text); private chat: none named

editGeneralForumTopic.purpose: Rename the 'General' topic of a forum supergroup.
use_when: giving General a name that fits the forum, e.g. Lobby

pitfalls.text: name is required, 1-128 characters; there is no icon parameter.
pitfalls.cite: editGeneralForumTopic parameters: chat_id, name (New topic name, 1-128 characters)

pitfalls.text: General is addressed by chat_id alone, with no message_thread_id.
pitfalls.cite: editGeneralForumTopic parameters: chat_id, name

closeGeneralForumTopic.purpose: Close the open 'General' topic of a forum supergroup.
use_when: pausing general chatter while the other topics stay open

pitfalls.text: General is addressed by chat_id alone, with no message_thread_id.
pitfalls.cite: closeGeneralForumTopic parameters: chat_id

pitfalls.text: hideGeneralForumTopic closes it too.
pitfalls.cite: hideGeneralForumTopic: The topic will be automatically closed if it was open.

pitfalls.text: Unlike closeForumTopic, no exception for a bot that created the topic.
pitfalls.cite: closeGeneralForumTopic: must have the can_manage_topics administrator rights

reopenGeneralForumTopic.purpose: Reopen the closed 'General' topic of a forum supergroup; a hidden General is unhidden too.
use_when: bringing back a hidden General in one call

pitfalls.text: Reopening also unhides General if it was hidden.
pitfalls.cite: reopenGeneralForumTopic: The topic will be automatically unhidden if it was hidden.

pitfalls.text: General is addressed by chat_id alone, with no message_thread_id.
pitfalls.cite: reopenGeneralForumTopic parameters: chat_id

hideGeneralForumTopic.purpose: Hide the 'General' topic of a forum supergroup; an open General is closed too.
use_when: a forum where every message belongs in a named topic

pitfalls.text: Hiding also closes General if it was open.
pitfalls.cite: hideGeneralForumTopic: The topic will be automatically closed if it was open.

pitfalls.text: To show and open it again in one call, use reopenGeneralForumTopic (it unhides); unhideGeneralForumTopic's text says nothing about reopening.
pitfalls.cite: reopenGeneralForumTopic: The topic will be automatically unhidden if it was hidden.

unhideGeneralForumTopic.purpose: Unhide the 'General' topic of a forum supergroup.
avoid_when: General should also be open again: reopenGeneralForumTopic unhides and reopens

pitfalls.text: Its text does not say it reopens General, which hiding closed; whether it stays closed was not tested.
General is addressed by chat_id alone, with no message_thread_id.
pitfalls.cite: unhideGeneralForumTopic parameters: chat_id

unpinAllGeneralForumTopicMessages.purpose: Clear the pinned messages of the 'General' topic of a forum supergroup.

pitfalls.text: The right is can_pin_messages, not can_manage_topics.
pitfalls.cite: unpinAllGeneralForumTopicMessages: must have the can_pin_messages administrator right in the supergroup

pitfalls.text: General is addressed by chat_id alone, with no message_thread_id.
pitfalls.cite: unpinAllGeneralForumTopicMessages parameters: chat_id

getForumTopicIconStickers.purpose: List the custom emoji stickers allowed as topic icons; their custom_emoji_id goes to createForumTopic or editForumTopic.
avoid_when: fetching arbitrary custom emoji by id: getCustomEmojiStickers, but only this list is allowed as topic icons

pitfalls.text: Takes no parameters and returns an array of Sticker; the icon id is each Sticker's custom_emoji_id.
pitfalls.cite: getForumTopicIconStickers: Requires no parameters. Returns an Array of Sticker objects.

pitfalls.text: Only these ids are allowed as topic icons.
pitfalls.cite: icon_custom_emoji_id: Use getForumTopicIconStickers to get all allowed custom emoji identifiers.

pitfalls.text: Fetch once and cache the list; don't call it per topic.
